posts.raw_content:
...No Jesus, No Peace...Know Jesus, Know Peace...

“Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.” —Joshua 1:9

...Thru the Bible with Dr. J. Vernon McGee   Exodus 32:26—33:23...

Our honesty with God moves His heart more than perfectly worded prayers ever can. Moses’ humble, honest prayer of confession stirred God’s heart to not yet give up on the people of Israel. Exodus 32 teaches us that, if we fail to admit we need God’s presence in our lives, we will forever stay lost in the wilderness.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-with-j-vernon-mcgee/player/exodus-3226-3323-1295428.html?type=branded#now-playing

https://ttb.org/

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

He doesn’t need our vote

“He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.” You see, He’s gone back to heaven. He gets the kingdom from the Father, not from you and me. We don’t vote Him in. When He comes next time, we’re told that He’ll dash them in pieces with a rod of iron. Friends, He’s not asking anybody to vote for Him when He comes the next time. They’ll either receive Him or they’ll be destroyed. That’s the way it will be next time. He came the first time as a Savior. Now He said He’s gone away to receive a kingdom. “And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come. But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.” And that’s just about what the world is saying to Him today. But that’s not going to keep God from sending Him to the earth.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/he-doesnt-need-our-vote-1296546.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: [it is] the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast. (Ephesians 2:8-9)

We are saved through the grace of God and only the grace of God. There is no other way for us to get to heaven. If we think the good we do will earn us a hope in heaven, then we shall be deeply dismayed when Jesus says, "Depart from me, I never knew you." Let us not take pride in ourselves in thinking that our works will get us into heaven. Let us rather praise the Lord for His marvelous grace!

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm

...Sometimes you have to give up things for God...

And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. -- Luke 9:23

Sometimes God wants us to give up things in our lives, so they do not stand in the way of the work He wants to do.

https://digginganotherwell.substack.com/p/sometimes-you-have-to-give-up-things-for-god

...C. H. Spurgeon's Evening Reading (October 9th)...

"But He answered her not a word." — Matthew 15:23

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?Time=pm

...C. H. Spurgeon's Morning Reading (October 10th)...

"Faultless before the presence of His glory." — Jude 1:24

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?doy=284




...Faith Plus Nothing Equals Salvation...

https://youtu.be/fDR0mu18x80?si=aG5gQZZ3noLTFzQk

https://blueletterbible.org/Comm/mcgee_j_vernon/eBooks/faith-plus-zero-equals-salvation.cfm

“The sin underneath all our sins is to trust the lie of the serpent that we cannot trust the love and grace of Christ and must take matters into our own hands” - Martin Luther

Head Up

Eyes Forward

Hold The Line Patriots

Keep Calm

And

Howl On
